arithmetic_note: Percentages are 100 * (candidate - current) / current for the same replicate/profile. Descriptive differences only; no new statistical classification or A21 noise judgement. Percentiles were copied from original exact-sample metadata; no request samples or histogram bins were reprocessed.

recommendation.decision: Keep a5748 as a promising scheduling experiment, with explicit CPU and server-stream p99 tradeoffs. It is not yet a retained final product.
reasons: Candidate p99 is lower in 13 of 15 paired case observations: all unary, client-stream and duplex pairs, and one server-stream pair. Two server-stream p99 pairs are higher.
Active sampled server CPU is higher in all six profile pairs. The absolute rise is about 1.40 to 2.30 percentage points of one core.
Allocation and RSS stay in the same order as the current buffer implementation. After-idle RSS is slightly higher in all three unary pairs and mixed for streams.

All twelve cells passed original correctness/service/recovery/drain predicates and all thirty-seven finite commands retired. This does not classify statistical significance or prove high-load/long-run behavior.
source_based_unmeasured_costs: Only existing coordinator constructor arguments change from the 10 ms default to 1 ms; callback state machine, native sources and per-message buffer code are unchanged.

More frequent timer callbacks still scan the full fixed coordinator capacity. No timer-frequency, per-scan CPU or idle-CPU attribution is present in these result summaries; a scan-bound optimization remains a separate unimplemented hypothesis.
The Data.NativeHost argument also changes in this commit but this protocol workload does not execute database operations and grants no database evidence.
Both roles retain the same extra buffer-grant/reap/growth behavior from ea006; this comparison does not isolate or eliminate those inherited costs.
recommendation.required_before_later_retention_claim: Keep cleanup and original error/resource/tail criteria, decide whether the measured active-CPU cost warrants a separately reviewed small experiment, then use actual same-commit native/full producers and unchanged formal EA5 comparison plus capacity and long acceptance.
